title: Noor and the Drop
author: Elodie Eriksen
blurb: Elodie Sandoval, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
